description: This file contains unit tests for the slot management component of the Cobalt loader application, including library loading, version comparison, and file existence checks.

classes.name: MockLibraryLoader
classes.description: Mock class for loading libraries, used in unit tests to simulate library loading and symbol resolution.

classes.name: SlotManagementTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for slot management tests, parameterized by whether compression is used.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes paths and checks system path for storage directory.

methods.name: AddFileExtension
methods.description: Appends appropriate file extension based on test parameter (compression).

methods.name: CreatePath
methods.description: Constructs a filesystem path from path elements.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: CreateBadFile
methods.description: Creates a 'bad' app key file in the specified slot.

methods.name: CreateGoodFile
methods.description: Creates a 'good' app key file in the specified slot.

methods.name: VerifyGoodFile
methods.description: Verifies existence of a 'good' app key file.

methods.name: VerifyBadFile
methods.description: Verifies existence of a 'bad' app key file.

methods.name: CreateDrainFile
methods.description: Creates a drain file for the specified slot and app key.

methods.name: VerifyLoad
methods.description: Mocks and verifies library loading process.

methods.name: CreateDirs
methods.description: Creates directory structure for library files.

methods.name: CreateEmptyLibraryFile
methods.description: Creates an empty library file in the appropriate directory for a slot.
